annotations.annotation_text: Viconian philosophical framework: Giambattista Vico's cyclical schema of history (divine theocratic age, heroic aristocratic age, human democratic age, and ricorso), invoked through "human".
sources: Vico, Giambattista. Scienza Nuova (The New Science, 1725). https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
Beckett, Samuel, et al. Our Exagmination Round His Factification... https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Giambattista Vico. https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/

annotations.annotation_text: The Twelve Jurors / Tavern Drinkers (Tap): representing the chorus of public opinion, the twelve signs of the Zodiac, the Apostles, and the customers gossiping in HCE's Chapelizod pub.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
